description: Image Description: The image shows a wine tasting setup with five glasses of wine arranged on a white mat. Each glass contains a different amount of red wine, with the first and fifth glasses having more wine than the others. The glasses are placed on orange coasters, and beneath them on the mat are labels with names and vintages of the wines. In the center of the mat is a rectangular label that reads "Guía Peñín Live Tasting." The scene suggests a formal wine tasting event
